relationships.subject: AC1
relationships.evidence_quote: Genetic deletion of AC1 or pharmacological inhibition of AC1 blocked post-LTP in the ACC and IC

relationships.subject: ACC-NAc pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic inhibition of the ACC-NAc pathway alleviates the behavioral empathic pain in mice.

key_findings: ACC and IC are central to emotional/empathic pain; cortical LTP is a key synaptic mechanism.
AC1 is proposed as a therapeutic target for chronic pain and associated emotional disorders.
